About

From EEE graduate to SCADA engineer

I am an Electrical and Electronics Engineering graduate specializing in SCADA and Substation Automation Systems, with practical exposure to electrical commissioning, protection and control, RTU configuration and industrial automation.

My engineering journey began with an internship at JJ Pump Pvt. Ltd., where I gained exposure to motor manufacturing and assembly processes. I subsequently gained practical experience in relay retrofitting, electrical wiring and commissioning activities at KPTCL Mysuru Division.

Currently, I am working as an Associate Engineer at Agile Electromechanical Contracting Private Limited, contributing to the Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL) project. My current technical activities involve SCADA configuration, training simulator development, signal mapping, alarm normalization, ETS logic configuration, SLD modifications and testing of electrical indications.

I am continuously developing my technical knowledge in IEC 61850 communication, protection and control engineering, RTU integration and digital substation automation. My long-term ambition is to become a highly skilled SCADA and Substation Automation Engineer and contribute to major power infrastructure and automation projects internationally.
